evidence.title: openFDA drug data
excerpts: FDA enforcement report D-0337-2015 (classification Class II, initiated 20141215): Failed Capsule/Tablet Specifications: Actavis has received several complaint for clumping and breaking of capsules with some bottles showing popped out bottle b.

FDA enforcement report D-0354-2023 (classification Class III, initiated 20230217): Presence of Foreign Tablets/Capsules: Pharmacist reported presence of some Gabapentin tablets 800 mg comingled in Gabapentin 600 mg 500 count bottles..
FDA enforcement report D-0208-2020 (classification Class II, initiated 20190812): Lack of Assurance of Sterility.
FDA enforcement report D-1232-2020 (classification Class II, initiated 20200318): CGMP Deviations: Products were manufactured in a processing area in which water leakage was observed.

FDA enforcement report D-696-2015 (classification Class II, initiated 20141114): Penicillin Cross Contamination: All lots of all products repackaged and distributed between 01/05/12 and 02/12/15 are being recalled because they were repackage.

FDA enforcement report D-0031-2026 (classification Class II, initiated 20251010): Failed Impurities/Degradation Specifications: an out of specification result obtained during routine stability testing for Highest Unknown Impurity ..
FDA enforcement report D-0320-2025 (classification Class II, initiated 20250313): CGMP Deviations.
FDA enforcement report D-0312-2025 (classification Class III, initiated 20250304): Cross Contamination.

FDA enforcement report D-329-2013 (classification Class III, initiated 20130405): Chemical Contamination: Gabapentin Sodium tablets is recalled due to complaints related to an off - odor described as moldy, musty or fishy in nature..

FDA enforcement report D-0336-2015 (classification Class II, initiated 20141215): Failed Capsule/Tablet Specifications: Actavis has received several complaint for clumping and breaking of capsules with some bottles showing popped out bottle b.
